Drawback: Cooldown.name: Drawback: Cooldown
Drawback: Cooldown.description:
⏳ After a big use, your Quirk needs time to reset.

⚠️ The harder you push it, the more often it goes quiet when you need it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirk: Tenya Iida (Engine).
Drawback: Cooldown.traitNarrativeEffects:
After heavy use the Quirk needs a pause before it answers again; the pause fits the family (a stall, a dimmed glow, a lock in the limbs, a silence where the Quirk should be).
Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): activation lags a beat; after a heavy or severe use the Quirk stays quiet through the user's next turn.
Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; after any use beyond light the Quirk stays quiet through the user's next turn, and the user feels it grinding when they try.
Quirk Strain 100: the Quirk shuts down completely and will not restart until Strain falls below 60; the user is unhurt but has only body and gear.
The signs fade as Strain falls back below each threshold.
Ordinary life: little changes day to day; the user plans uses in sequence, saves the big one for when it counts, and is known for a pause opponents learn to wait out.
